description: The AUTOPILOT project partners publish connected-driving logs from an 11.6-kilometre roadworks demonstration near Livorno, Italy. Zenodo supplies seven archives free under CC BY 4.0. One automated vehicle and two connected vehicles exchanged roadside and cloud messages using ITS-G5, oneM2M and an electronic-horizon service. Logged variables include GPS, speed, steering and battery signals together with roadwork notifications and map or hazard messages. These records can benchmark communication and vehicle-response components in traffic digital twins. Related G6 data-autopilot-brainport-roadside-camera-obstacle-logs covers a separate Dutch test-track demonstration. Coverage is the documented Italian scenarios, not representative national traffic. Timing alignment and operational context are needed to interpret responses; notification receipt alone does not demonstrate safety improvement. No archive was downloaded or latency and behaviour results reproduced.
